name: capell-app/layout-builder
description: Compose Capell pages from reusable widgets in shared layouts, edited in place or rearranged, with bulk widget replacement.

suggest.capell-app/ai-orchestrator: Adds AI-assisted layout planning through AI Orchestrator.
suggest.capell-app/content-sections: Allows reusable content sections in layouts.
suggest.capell-app/filament-peek: Keeps unsaved layout changes visible in Filament Peek previews.
suggest.capell-app/html-cache: Clears cached pages that show a widget when the widget changes.
suggest.capell-app/navigation: Adds navigation widgets and demo navigation menus.
suggest.capell-app/publishing-studio: Connects layout snapshots to publishing workflows.
suggest.capell-app/structured-content-library: Allows structured content records in layouts.
suggest.capell-app/theme-foundation: Provides shared Blade rendering for installed layouts.
